plugin.name: NetBird
plugin.description: Lists the peers of your NetBird network, signs you in with your identity provider or a token, imports peers as hosts and explains which access policy lets Termix reach them.

panel.notConfigured: Set a NetBird token in Settings, Plugins, NetBird, or ask your admin to set up sign-in.
panel.tokenRejected: NetBird rejected the credential. Sign in again or check the token.
panel.apiError: The NetBird management API could not be read.
panel.empty: No peers in this NetBird network.
panel.termixPeerMissing: The Termix peer from the settings is not in this network.
panel.termixPeerUnset: Set the Termix peer in the settings to check SSH reachability.
panel.signInNeeded: Sign in to NetBird to see your peers.
panel.policiesHidden: Your NetBird account may not read access policies, so reachability is not checked.
panel.forbidden: NetBird accepted the sign-in but does not let it list peers. In NetBird, regular users may be blocked from the dashboard and the API (Settings, Permissions), or the token lacks rights.
panel.fallback: NetBird rejected your own sign-in, so the shared service token is used. Check your personal access token or sign in again.
panel.restricted: NetBird shows users with the role "user" only their own peers. To see all peers, give the user the role admin or auditor in NetBird, or use the service token.
panel.emptyRestricted: No peers belong to this NetBird user. NetBird shows users with the role "user" only their own peers.

reach.postureChecks: Posture checks apply and can still block the connection.
reach.blockedHint: No NetBird policy lets the Termix peer open TCP {{port}} to this peer.

view.title: View NetBird peers
view.description: See every peer of the NetBird network, its groups and which policies reach it.

import.title: Import NetBird peers as hosts
import.description: Add selected NetBird peers as hosts owned by the user.

managementUrl.label: Management URL
managementUrl.description: Your self-hosted management server, for example https://vpn.example.com. Leave empty for NetBird Cloud.

apiToken.label: Service token
apiToken.description: A personal access token of a NetBird service user. Used for everyone in the "Service token" mode and as the fallback in "Own sign-in, else service token". Read access is enough; an auditor role is recommended.

termixPeer.label: Termix peer
termixPeer.description: The NetBird peer this Termix server runs on: its name, DNS label or NetBird IP. Used for the SSH reachability check.

sshPort.label: SSH port
sshPort.description: The port the reachability check and new hosts use.

authMode.label: Sign-in mode
authMode.description: Who the plugin talks to NetBird as. With an own sign-in, NetBird applies each user's own permissions.
authMode.userOrService: Own sign-in (SSO or own token), else service token
authMode.user: Own sign-in only (SSO or own token)

oidcIssuer.label: Issuer URL
oidcIssuer.description: The OpenID Connect issuer whose tokens your NetBird management server accepts, for example its built-in IdP (https://vpn.example.com/oauth2) or your Keycloak, Zitadel, Authentik or Entra ID realm. Leave empty to turn single sign-on off.

oidcClientId.label: Client ID
oidcClientId.description: A client NetBird accepts tokens from (its audience), usually the NetBird dashboard client. Register the redirect URI shown in the NetBird panel for it.

oidcClientSecret.label: Client secret
oidcClientSecret.description: Only for a confidential client. Leave empty for a public client with PKCE.

oidcScopes.label: Scopes
oidcScopes.description: offline_access gives a refresh token, so users stay signed in.

oidcAudience.label: Audience
oidcAudience.description: Optional audience parameter, needed by some providers (Auth0) to issue an API token for NetBird.

oidcExtraParams.label: Extra authorization parameters
oidcExtraParams.description: Optional, as key=value&key=value. For example connector_id=<id> to skip the connector choice of a Dex based IdP.

oidcUseIdToken.label: Send the ID token
oidcUseIdToken.description: Send the ID token instead of the access token to NetBird. Only for setups where NetBird validates ID tokens.

checkPorts.label: Ports to check
checkPorts.description: More ports for the access explanation in the peer details, comma separated, for example 3389, 5900 for RDP and VNC.

userApiToken.label: Your NetBird access token
userApiToken.description: Your own NetBird personal access token (starts with nbp_; paste only the token, without "Token"). Used when you are not signed in with SSO and the sign-in mode allows an own sign-in. NetBird then applies your role: with the role "user" you see only your own peers.

auth.popupBlocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for Termix and try again.
auth.notConfigured: Single sign-on is not set up. An admin can enter the identity provider in the plugin settings.
auth.redirectUri: Redirect URI to register at the identity provider: {{uri}}
auth.orToken: Or set your own NetBird access token in your plugin settings.
auth.userTokenIgnored: Your own access token is saved but not used: the sign-in mode is "service token for everyone". An admin can switch it to an own sign-in.

import.title: Add {{count}} peers as hosts
import.credentialNone: None, set it later in the host
import.tagGroups: Tag hosts with their NetBird groups
import.error: The hosts could not be added.

detail.error: The details could not be loaded.
detail.loginExpired: Login expired: the peer needs to sign in again
detail.otherPorts: Rules between these peers on other ports
detail.disabled: Matching rules that are switched off
detail.noTermixPeer: Set the Termix peer in the settings to see which policy reaches this peer.
